notablePrerequisites:
You control creatures that can produce at least {1}{W}{U}.
Emry does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{U}.
Activate Emry by tapping them, allowing you to cast Sky Hussar from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sky Hussar from your graveyard by paying {3}{W}{U}.
Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sky Hussar, adding {2}.
Repeat.
